import * as C from "@constants";

import imgPercentileAggHyperfunction from "../../../../../assets/images/build/data-management/percentile_agg_hyperfunction.svg?url";

Real-time analytics needs more than basic aggregates, especially as data volume grows. {C.TIMESCALE_DB} {C.HYPERFUNC} are SQL-native helpers built for time-series analysis: they process, aggregate, and analyze large volumes efficiently so you can run sophisticated queries and still hit interactive latencies.

{C.HYPERFUNC_CAP} introduce partial aggregation, letting {C.TIMESCALE_DB} store intermediate states instead of raw data or final results. These partials can be merged later for rollups (consolidation), eliminating costly reprocessing and slashing compute overhead, especially when paired with {C.CAGG}s.

Take tracking p95 latency across thousands of app instances as an example:

- With standard SQL, every rollup requires rescanning and resorting massive datasets.
- With {C.TIMESCALE_DB}, the `percentile_agg` hyperfunction stores a compact state per minute, which you simply merge to get hourly or daily percentiles, no full reprocess needed.

<img src={imgPercentileAggHyperfunction} alt="percentile_agg hyperfunction in Tiger Console" />

The result? Scalable, real-time percentile analytics that deliver fast, accurate insights across high-ingest, high-resolution data, while keeping resource use lean.

{C.CLOUD_LONG} includes all {C.HYPERFUNC} by default, while {C.SELF_SHORT} {C.TIMESCALE_DB} includes a subset of them. To include all {C.HYPERFUNC} with {C.TIMESCALE_DB}, install the [{C.TOOLKIT_LONG}](/deploy/self-hosted/tooling/install-toolkit) {C.PG} extension on your {C.SELF_SHORT} {C.PG} deployment.

For more information, read the [{C.HYPERFUNC} blog post](https://www.tigerdata.com/blog/time-series-analytics-for-postgresql-introducing-the-timescale-analytics-project).

## Learn hyperfunction basics and install {C.TOOLKIT_LONG}

- [Learn about {C.HYPERFUNC}](/learn/hyperfunctions/about-hyperfunctions) to understand how they
  work before using them.
- Install the [{C.TOOLKIT_LONG} extension](/deploy/self-hosted/tooling/install-toolkit) to access more
  {C.HYPERFUNC} on {C.SELF_SHORT} {C.TIMESCALE_DB}.
